items.source: The column name for the primary key if it is of a simple type, else ignored.
items.translation: 如果主键为简单类型，则为主键的列名；否则忽略。

items.source: Use PrimaryKeyColumn in conjunction with Id to specify extended primary key column properties.
items.translation: 使用 PrimaryKeyColumn 与 Id 配合，以指定扩展主键列属性。

items.source: Remember, if the Cassandra table has multiple primary key columns, then you must define a class annotated with PrimaryKeyClass to represent the primary key!
items.translation: 请记住，如果 Cassandra 表有多个主键列，则必须定义一个带有 PrimaryKeyClass 注解的类来表示主键！

items.source: Alex Shvid, Matthew T. Adams, Mark Paluch
items.translation: 亚历克斯·什维德，马修·T·亚当斯，马克·帕卢奇

items.source: Identifies the primary key field of the entity, which may be of a basic type or of a type that represents a composite primary key class. This field corresponds to the PRIMARY KEY of the corresponding Cassandra table. Only one field in a given type hierarchy may be annotated with this annotation.
items.translation: 识别实体的主键字段，该字段可以是基本类型或表示复合主键类的类型。此字段对应于相应的 Cassandra 表中的 `PRIMARY KEY`。在给定类型层次结构中，只能有一个字段被此注解标记。
